title: Pull-request labels Jig writes and reads

kind.description: state for a label that shows where a pull request's drive or follow-up stands, command for a label a person adds for the dispatcher to act on.

name.description: The label's name without the repository's prefix (dispatch.labels.prefix, jig: by default): a pull request carries the prefix followed by this name.

writers.description: For a state label, who adds it, comma-separated: drive, followup (the follow-up of a merged pull request) and tick (the dispatcher's tick, which corrects every state label that disagrees with the pull request's drive ledger). Null for a command label, which only a person adds.

meaning.description: What the label says, as the label setup gives it as the label's description on the forge.

values.name: driving
values.meaning: A drive runs on this pull request, or the dispatcher re-arms the one that stopped

values.name: converged
values.meaning: The drive converged at the pull request's head: a person merges

values.name: parked
values.meaning: The drive stopped on something only a person settles

values.name: stale
values.meaning: Its drive converged then went stale, or stopped or parked on a conflict: the dispatcher re-drives it

values.name: held
values.meaning: Waits its turn in a serialized change area: the dispatcher drives it once it leads

values.name: followed-up
values.meaning: Merged, and its follow-up is done

values.name: followup-failed
values.meaning: Merged, and its follow-up failed: a person acts

values.name: drive
values.meaning: A person asks the dispatcher to drive this pull request

values.name: rearm
values.meaning: A person asks the dispatcher to re-arm a stopped drive in its existing tree

values.name: hold
values.meaning: A person stands the dispatcher down from this pull request
